scientific_integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from the standard pure-Pólya beta limit and uses exact recurrence, conditional martingale tail bounds, logarithmic product convergence, and finite-prefix coupling. Included finite computations are diagnostics only.
scientific_limitations: Two colours, fixed integer additions with c,b>0, positive fixed initial counts, rowwise independent rule choices and weak endpoint convergence. No quantitative rate, process limit, or independent proof verification is claimed.
title: Logarithmic rare-Friedman crossover for a mixed two-colour Pólya urn
